terminal_reason: MERGED #13241 (e3af98f9) + #14534 (b00d9dc3); DEPLOYED and OBSERVED 2026-09-30. #13241: stop-bot-service writes runtime_logs/trader_operator_stop.json, and deploy_pull_restart.sh holds ict-trader-live while it exists -- this is the clear condition ('no longer starts an inactive ict-trader-live (stop-marker), with a test'). #14534: the raw-`systemctl stop` case is intentionally NOT held. systemd cannot tell it from a mount drop or a reset-failed crash, which must still be revived (Prime Directive). A deliberate stop goes through stop_bot, which writes the marker and pauses autoheal. The deploy now logs 'starting stopped <unit>' when it starts a stopped long-running unit, and purge_vm_runner's reset-failed is scoped to claude-vm-runner@*. It restarted every long-running unit (ict-trader-live, ict-web-api, ict-telegram-bot, ict-claude-bridge, ict-claude-decision-bot) with no 'hold', 'starting stopped' or WARNING line; web-api git_sha 02b19ea12 matched HEAD. /api/diag/status at ~06:26:47Z: bot_uptime_s 413 (started ~06:19:54, matching that restart), git_sha_running 02b19ea12, heartbeat age 11 s.
what: ict-git-sync (scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh) runs `systemctl restart` on every ict-*.service when main advances, which STARTS a deliberately stopped ict-trader-live. MEASURED: stop-bot-service #13194 stopped the trader 14:15:23Z; git-sync restarted it 14:16:59Z and 14:22:27Z, so the forced cancels #13203/#13204 at 14:39Z hit Error 326 (clientId 497 in use by the revived trader). stop_bot.sh guards only the liveness watchdog. git-sync also restarts ict-liveness-watchdog.service (the oneshot) while its timer is paused. Proposed Tier-2 fix: deploy_pull_restart.sh should `try-restart` (restart only if active) for ict-trader-live, or skip units whose last stop was an operator stop (stop_bot writes a marker; start_bot clears it).
